edges.sentence: On 2026-08-29, PBS NewsHour reported “Citing the importance of the First Amendment, a federal judge in California says the U.S. government is unconstitutionally silencing critics of Israel's war in Gaza and others as part of the Trump administration 's quest to deport noncitizens who it says disrupted college campuses while expressing their views.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “La jueza citó fallas relacionadas con la libertad de expresión y con la imprecisión que violan la Primera y la Quinta Enmienda constitucionales, al anular partes de las disposiciones que sigue el gobierno federal en materia de deportaciones.”.
